Judgment
This appeal is filed by the claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 17.08.2019 passed by the Tribunal, in MVC No.575/2016 seeking enhancement of compensation.

2. Heard the arguments and perused the material placed before the Court.
3.
The occurrence of accident, injuries sustained by the claimant, coverage of insurance are not in dispute in this case.
4. In the present case, from the medical evidence on record it is proved that the claimant had suffered the following injuries.
i) Fracture displacement of left index proximal phalynx.

ii) Fracture of left hand thumb distal phalynx NC: 2023:KHC-D:13239 iii) Dislocation of left hand ring finger distal phalynx.
5.

The tribunal has awarded compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads.
Amount in  No. (Rs.)
1. Towards pain and suffering.

50,000/-
 2. Towards medical expenses.

1,68,000/-
 3. Towards loss of income during 32,000/-
 treatment period.

5. Towards food, diet and future 30,000/-
 treatment
Prakash

2  6. Towards disability 1,03,680/-
Considering the nature of injuries sustained, compensation awarded by tribunal is on lesser side.
Therefore, the same is required to be enhanced by modifying the judgment and award.

7. Considering the injuries sustained, a compensation of Rs.60,000/- towards pain and suffering,
Rs.30,000/- towards loss of amenities are awarded.
The compensation awarded towards medical expenses and NC: 2023:KHC-D:13239 hospital charges of Rs.1,68,000/- is as per the actual bills and receipts produced; therefore, the same is kept intact.

Further, Rs.20,000/- towards incidental expenses like food, nourishment, traveling, attendant charges, etc., and Rs.26,250/- (8,750/- x 3)
towards loss of income during laid up period for a period of three months, is awarded.
8. The doctor has stated that the claimant had suffered 18% of physical disability to the whole body.
Therefore, considering the evidence of the doctor, 10% functional disability is taken into consideration as the claimant had suffered fracture and other grievous injuries.
9. The Tribunal has contributed 20% of contributory negligence on the part of the claimant.
Considering the scenario of the accident and location of accident mentioned in the complaint and spot sketch, the contributory negligence has to be modified.

Accordingly, it is modified that the claimant has contributed 15% towards rashness and negligence and driver of tractor has NC:
2023:KHC-D:13239 contributed 85% towards rashness and negligence.
Accordingly, it is modified.
10. The accident is caused in the year 2016.
Therefore, notional income of Rs.8,750/- per month is taken into consideration, which is recognized by the Karnataka State Legal Service Authority.
The claimant was aged 20 years at the time of accident.
Therefore appropriate applicable multiplier is 18.

Hence, loss of future income due to disability is hereby reassessed and quantified as Rs.2,83,500/- (Rs.8,750/- x 18 x 15/100 x 12).
11.

Thus, the claimant is entitled for total compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl. Heads.

Amount in  No. (Rs.)
 1. Towards injuries, pain and 60,000/-
 suffering.
 2. Towards medical expenses.
 3. Towards loss of amenities.

30,000/-
 4. Towards loss of income during 26,250/-
 laid up period and medical  treatment period.

5. Towards incidental charges like 20,000/-
 attendant charges, food,

3  NC: 2023:KHC-D:13239 nourishment, conveyance, etc.,.
6. Towards loss of future earning 2,83,500/-
capacity.
Total: 4,19,750/-
12.

Therefore, the claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.4,19,750/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of filing of the petition till realization, as against Rs.3,83,680/-
awarded by the Tribunal.

13. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is allowed in part.
ii) The judgment and award dated 17.08.2019 passed by the Principal Senior Civil Judge and MACT, Jamkhandi, in MVC No.575/2016 stands modified.
iii) The claimant is entitled for total compensation of Rs.4,19,750/- along with interest at the rate of 6% p.a. from the date of petition till its realization.
NC: 2023:KHC-D:13239 iv) The claimant is not entitled for interest for the delayed period of 17 days in filing the appeal.
v) The insurance company shall deposit the amount within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
vi) Send back the trial Court records along with a copy of this judgment.
vii) No order as to costs.
viii) Draw award accordingly.

SD/-
